title: Explicit registry-only session assignment routing
command: cargo test --manifest-path workflow-tools/Cargo.toml --locked -p session-api -p session-workspace-resolver -p mcp-toolmon --lib
detail: Regression: unregistered session-named checkout must not assign a session. Only explicit main-store registration selects an isolated checkout. Check registry changes, inactive/malformed/missing assignments, canonical/legacy stores, unchanged manifests, and canonical Ticket/Spec/Test proxy calls. Capture-hook suite separately verifies registered routing and no fallback for broken registration. Full-package reload and handoff fixture failures remain separately reported; this gate covers shared library tests only.
